advisor_identified: Medieval Mediterranean historian at McGill University, previously Wichita State University; co-supervisor of Sonya Pihura’s wetland-environments dissertation.

doctorate.title: The Taifa of Denia and the Medieval Mediterranean

evidence.says: McGill identifies Bruce as an associate professor specializing in medieval intercultural relations and lists a PhD from Western Michigan University and a Doctorat from Université de Toulouse.
Western Michigan’s repository records Travis Bruce’s The Taifa of Denia and the Medieval Mediterranean, awarded August 2010, Doctor of Philosophy, Department of History.
The 2023 departmental newsletter, page 13, lists Sonya Pihura’s Conceptions, Uses, and Transformations of Wetland Environments in England c.1000-1400 with supervisors Faith Wallis and Travis Bruce.
The indexed authority record identifies a doctorate in medieval history at Toulouse 2 in 2009 and lists La Taifa de Denia et la Méditerranée au Ve / XIe siècle, directed by Philippe Senac.

notes: The linked AHA record matches the author, institution, department, year and dissertation subject; its title adds “Hispano-Muslim” to the repository title. Bruce also earned a Doctorat at Université de Toulouse 2–Le Mirail in 2009; the doctorate object records the Western Michigan PhD relevant to the linked record. The Persée authority details were available in the search index; direct retrieval failed.
